titulo: The table wiped before I can offer
caption:
The table wiped before I can offer

My friend cooks, then wipes the table before I can offer. Then I started offering first.

Clearing your own spot takes about ten seconds, and it is one of the things a host tends to notice.

For whoever wipes the table after cooking.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table and a few crumbs on it. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one on the right. A bubble says thanks for dinner and the blue one answers anytime. The blue one looks down, leans over the table, the crumbs vanish and a bubble says got them. The black one's eyes go wide and then happy, the blue one's too, and both pulse. The text stays: them wiping the table after cooking for me. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
